scheme_name: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)

clauses.text: The Tamil Nadu Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS), co-branded as AB-PMJAY-CMCHIS since its 2018 integration with the central Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY scheme, provides cashless health insurance coverage to eligible Tamil Nadu families for a defined list of medical and surgical procedures at network hospitals, as notified under GO(Ms) No.560, Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu.
Eligible families receive cashless treatment coverage of up to Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year across the scheme's listed procedures.
The applicant must be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
The applicant's name must appear on the family's ration card issued in Tamil Nadu.
The applicant's annual family income must be under Rs. 1,20,000, as notified under GO(Ms) No.560, Health and Family Welfare Department.
